title: Fulfilled, a mail-order tycoon where AI wrote the code and the code draws everything
author: ScoreMysterious6910
selftext:
it's a tycoon about running a mail-order business out of a 1982 garage. orders come in, you pack them, the truck comes at eleven.

how it was made: AI tools did the building. they wrote the code and all the writing, the local paper stories, the crew's lines, the tutorial. there are no image files at all, every box and van is drawn by the game's code, and the music is made in code too. no image model, and nothing calls an AI while you play.

my part was direction. I picked the mechanics and how each interaction should feel, played the builds and said what was off.

free demo of the garage chapter, best on a computer for now: [https://playfulfilled.io/?utm\_source=reddit\_aigamedev](https://playfulfilled.io/?utm_source=reddit_aigamedev)

curious how you all keep it looking like one game when the code draws everything.
